messages:
Lara: Quick check on the 'mini rows' experiment for the Rules list. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/minirows/test. Goal: fit more rules without losing controls. Thoughts? @Jon @Priya @Marco
Jon: Love the density but two concerns: focus order clarity and touch hit targets. If rows shrink visually, keep 44px minimum hit area and add visible focus outlines.
Priya: For microcopy, inline help should change from 'No match' to 'This rule won't match until you add a condition.' Short + explains next step.
Marco: Preview note: when multiple rules have equal priority the visual order feels arbitrary. Add a subtle "manual order" label and make reorder handle visible when user toggles edit-mode.
Lara: Also thinking about the inline validation display. Rather than blocking toasts, show a right-aligned pill: 'Needs condition' that opens details with Enter.
Jon: Accessibility: make drag handle a real button (role="button", aria-label="Reorder rule") and support keyboard reordering (mod+arrow). Use aria-live="polite" for inspector updates on selection change.
Priya: Small copy nits for empty preview: change to 'Run a preview to see which rules would match a sample request.' Add example payloads in a dropdown.
design-bot: Contrast scan: 2 tokens under AA in mini-rows (ids: lbl-3, lbl-9). Suggest color shift from #6B6F76 to #54585C.
Marco: Performance: rapid toggles of preview cause spinner to persist. Recommend cancel-inflight requests or debounce 250ms. I'll attach repro steps.
Lara: Action items: Priya to update copy strings and empty-state, Jon to spec a11y focus + keyboard reorder, Marco to add manual-order label + debounce repro, I'll update prototype with the pill and reduced-row visuals. Review in 48h.
Priya: Pushed copy updates to Figma.
Jon: I'll add keyboard reorder notes to the a11y doc and sync with eng.
Marco: Creating a tiny PR for the manual-order label and attaching spinner logs.
Lara: Thanks all :thumbsup:
